commands: echo "SKILL_DIR=${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-<unset>}"; echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<unset>}"; echo "REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-<unset>}"; ls -d .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts 2>/dev/null && echo "VENDOR_PRESENT" || echo "VENDOR_ABSENT"; ls skills/review/phases/ 2>/dev/null | head; pwd

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review.md | sed -n '50,85p' > /tmp/rev.txt
git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review-and-fix.md | sed -n '258,295p' > /tmp/raf.txt
echo "=== review.md gate ==="; cat /tmp/rev.txt
echo; echo "=== review-and-fix.md gate ==="; cat /tmp/raf.txt
git show FETCH_HEAD:CLAUDE.md > /tmp/new_claude.md; git show origin/main:CLAUDE.md > /tmp/old_claude.md; wc -l /tmp/new_claude.md /tmp/old_claude.md

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review.md > /tmp/rev_full.md
git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review-and-fix.md > /tmp/raf_full.md
git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/implement.md > /tmp/impl_full.md

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp && git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review.md > .prflow/tmp/rev.md && git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review-and-fix.md > .prflow/tmp/raf.md && git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/implement.md > .prflow/tmp/impl.md && echo done
git show FETCH_HEAD:CLAUDE.md > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/new_claude.md; git show origin/main:CLAUDE.md > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/old_claude.md
diff <(git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review.md | sed -n '48,82p') <(git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review-and-fix.md | sed -n '256,290p') && echo "IDENTICAL"
for f in implement review-and-fix receiving-code-review review create-issue; do echo "=== $f ==="; git grep -h -n "docs/internal" FETCH_HEAD -- .prflow/prompt-extensions/$f.md || echo "(none)"; done

a=$(git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review.md | sed -n '36,81p'); b=$(git show FETCH_HEAD:.prflow/prompt-extensions/review-and-fix.md | sed -n '244,289p'); if [ "$a" = "$b" ]; then echo "BYTE-IDENTICAL"; else echo "DIFFER"; fi

git show origin/main:CLAUDE.md | grep -oE "docs/internal/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+" | sort -u > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/old_refs.txt 2>/dev/null; git show FETCH_HEAD:CLAUDE.md | grep -oE "docs/internal/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+" | sort -u > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/new_refs.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "NEW refs not in old:"; comm -13 /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/old_refs.txt /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/new_refs.txt
comm -13 <(git show origin/main:CLAUDE.md | grep -oE "docs/internal/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+" | sort -u) <(git show FETCH_HEAD:CLAUDE.md | grep -oE "docs/internal/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+" | sort -u)

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
